runs.name: newcleo plc; Nasdaq NWCL (warrants NWCLW), SEC CIK 0002131813, foreign private issuer, formerly newcleo Ltd., statements in euros under IFRS; founded 2021, developing a 200 MWe Generation IV lead-cooled fast reactor and MOX fuel from spent fuel, revenue only from engineering, component and pump subsidiaries bought from 2023; listed 2026-09-21 by a business combination with NewHold Investment Corp III, a Cayman Islands SPAC
runs.box: OUT AT Q1; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$5.88** (close 2026-10-16, aggregator, flagged); the filer's own print $6.37 (2026-10-15, 424B3 cover). Shares **281,534,950** outstanding (424B3 resale prospectus 2026-10-16, `0001140361-26-039925`, The Offering; the same in the closing press release, 6-K 2026-10-05, `0001140361-26-038557`); not outstanding: 17,677,233 Class B earnout shares, about 8,855,000 NextChem warrants, options and RSUs; the prepaid forward of 2026-09-11 covers up to 7,000,000 shares, so the economic count may be up to 7,000,000 lower, the filed count used. Market value **$1,655.4M**. Sovereign **3.671%** (EUR, ECB AAA curve 30-year spot, 2026-10-15; statements in euros under IFRS). No 10-K or 20-F exists: read from the 424B3 resale prospectus of 2026-10-16 (Business, Competition, Legal Proceedings, Risk Factors, MD&A, Certain Relationships, audited FY2024 and FY2025 statements by Grant Thornton Dublin, report dated 2026-06-02, interim statements to 2026-06-30), the 6-Ks of 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-06; the proxy prospectus of 2026-08-10 searched for earlier audited years, none. Cross-check: cash 2026-06-30 EUR 66,540 thousand agrees in the press release and the prospectus. `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned nothing for this issuer; every figure from the filed statements. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the prospectus (six, listed in the run file). Rivals from the Competition section: NuScale and Oklo read from their filings (XBRL, flagged), X-energy files but no annual figures found, TerraPower not an SEC filer, GE Vernova's reactor not a reported segment. **Q1 OUT** **[L2007-015]**, **[M2008-088]**: founded 2021, "a development- and design-stage company" on its own MD&A, reactor and MOX fuel "not expected to generate revenues for several years", first reactor in the 2030s, French reactor opinion awaited, US pre-application only, every customer arrangement non-binding; a start-up, ruled out by kind; the ten-year economics also unforeseeable on the company's own statement ("we cannot accurately predict the amount, timing or duration of funding required") **[M2000-037]**, **[M2000-105]**, **[L2000-026]**, which alone would have closed TOO HARD (NATURE), recorded as concurring. After the stop, facts recorded, not judged: the FY2025 auditor's report carries a going-concern doubt; significant control deficiencies including revenue cut-off and contract existence; cash EUR 192.7M to EUR 66.5M in eighteen months, about EUR 233M preliminary at 2026-09-30; about $74.6M of the trust prepaid to the forward counterparty Tech Opportunities LLC; a $2.2 to $2.6 bn US fuel plant with no financing; a EUR 730.5M share-premium transfer turning the accumulated deficit into positive retained earnings; contract assets up while revenue fell 30%; EUR 9.7M of FY2025 SG&A labelled related party against EUR 0.3M in Note 27; Elysia Capital owned by the CEO in one section and by a former director in the note; the CEO's company leases the Turin head office. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after stock pay EUR (162.3)M FY2024, EUR (180.4)M FY2025, EUR (101.7)M H1 2026, no positive period and two audited years; **no value range and no fair price** computable. Rivals: NuScale operating losses every year 2022 to 2025 ($689.6M in 2025), Oklo no revenue; no named pure-play rival with an operating profit in any year shown. Contamination declared by the analyst: the opening commit subjects naming another company's run; none used. Commits 4e43dc10 (template), 7bbeb7cf (Step 0), 24b268de (Q1), fe94ec83 (the rest). Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_ids.py` clean; the dispatcher's `dispatcher_check.py`, 16 fragments closing before an id, none outside its row; no E-ids; **no citation slip**. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator** (the analyst's framework note): Q1 carries both the start-up rule (OUT) and the unforeseeable-economics routing (TOO HARD) and does not say which governs when both apply, nor define a start-up. Could not get: audited years before 2024; the share-consolidation ratio; what the EUR 9.7M related-party label covers; X-energy's figures; the 6-K exhibits of 2026-09-23 and 2026-09-25; the F-4 and F-1 texts; a treasury-share count.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1 (newcleo plc, Nasdaq NWCL, listed 2026-09-21 by a merger with the SPAC NewHold Investment Corp III; a pre-revenue developer of a 200 MWe lead-cooled fast reactor and MOX fuel, founded 2021, first reactor in the 2030s, every customer arrangement non-binding, its only revenue from engineering and pump subsidiaries bought from 2023; a start-up, ruled out by kind, the unforeseeable ten-year economics recorded as a concurring ground that alone would have given TOO HARD (NATURE). Facts recorded, not judged: a going-concern doubt in the FY2025 audit report, control deficiencies, cash down from EUR 192.7M to EUR 66.5M in eighteen months, $74.6M of trust money prepaid to a forward counterparty, two related-party contradictions inside the prospectus. Computation beneath the stop: owner cash negative in every period, no value range or fair price. No citation slip. Framework gap for the operator: Q1's start-up OUT and its TOO HARD routing when both apply, and no definition of a start-up.)
